Brock: "Keep the grit on it. You'll have enough shiny things by the time you get to the top."
Misty: "Sit by the rail a minute. I need to tell my team I'm the one who got that wrong."
Lt. Surge: "I keep a lamp on in the practice room. A trainer shouldn't have to learn every lesson in the dark."
Erika: "Take a moment by the window. The plants lean toward it even on the days it rains."
Koga: "Some people flinch when the poison takes hold. Others sell the flinch. I watch the hands."
Sabrina: "There was a sound at the door just before you came in. It was probably the door."
Blaine: "They'll want to know if you got my riddle. Tell them you asked me a better one."
Giovanni: "Ask for my name if they charge you for the door on the way out."
Falkner: "My father filed the first one by the window. He wanted to hear the birds while he worked."
Bugsy: "I put little questions in the margins of my notes. One of them has your name beside it now."
Whitney: "If you tell them I cried, at least tell them why. I really wanted to win."
Morty: "When the room's empty, you can hear somebody on the other side of the wall. I tell the staff it's my team."
Chuck: "Go out the front. The kids have been waiting to see what happens when somebody beats me."
Jasmine: "We hammer them smooth. I like the ones with a few dents better."
Pryce: "The floor doesn't remember the first person who slipped. I do. That's why we keep the bench there."
Clair: "If you came here for permission to be proud, don't wait around for mine."
Roxanne: "My students will ask how I lost. I'll tell them I was glad to have something worth going over."
Brawly: "The sea's coming in. Head out with somebody who knows which stones go under first."
Wattson: "Turn the switch by the door as you leave. I've been sitting in this light since morning."
Flannery: "My granddad taught me where to stand for the heat. Nobody told me where to put my hands afterward."
Norman: "My team did its job. It takes a while to be proud of them and sore about losing at the same time."
Winona: "You can tell which birds are ours. They always make a wider turn over the court."
Tate: "We both thought of a clever thing to say. Hers was kinder."
Liza: "We heard each other just fine today. We should've listened for you too."
Wallace: "When there's no crowd, you find out which part of a performance was for you."
Juan: "A student sees when the lesson has turned around. A teacher has to practice seeing it too."
Roark: "My dad would have let you take the shortcut through the mine. I wanted you to see what we do down here."
Gardenia: "Step close to the wall when you leave. The shadows in the middle do something I don't care for."
Maylene: "You can train until the city wakes up and still be surprised. I needed that."
Crasher Wake: "If they ask how loud it got, tell them you could hear my team. That's loud enough."
Fantina: "People think the ghosts love an audience. Mine are shy when anybody watches them come back."
Byron: "I tell Roark to brace before he swings. Hear him tell me the same damn thing now."
Candice: "The school kids picked who they thought would win. I'll let you see what they drew sometime."
Volkner: "Leave the breakers where they are. I'll go looking for something else to fix tomorrow."
Cilan: "You can put the same things in a dish twice and end up with two meals. I forgot to taste as I went."
Chili: "I thought if I kept the heat on, you'd back off. That's how I destroy the good pan."
Cress: "Chili will want to know what happened. Cilan will want to know what order it happened in."
Lenora: "Come by the archive when you've got half an hour. I'll show you the ink that survives the flooding."
Burgh: "I start my sketches with whatever refuses to sit still. You've given me plenty to draw."
Elesa: "The last picture's always the worst because people stop posing. I like to keep that one."
Clay: "Mind the yellow line on the platforms. We paint it for the folk who think they can't fall."
Skyla: "When we fly through with no visibility, somebody has to call us home. I like it better when it's a voice I know."
Brycen: "The director always called for quiet. Strange how seldom they waited long enough to hear it."
Drayden: "People will put ten different endings on our match by morning. We know what happened."
Iris: "I wanted to see what your team would do when I pushed them. I should've let mine surprise me too."
Viola: "Wait a heartbeat before you smile. I want the one you do when nobody tells you to."
Grant: "People remember how high you climbed. I remember when I was grateful for somebody's hand."
Korrina: "My grandpa's eyes go straight to Lucario when I get home. It took me years to understand that."
Ramos: "Go easy on the little ones when they get tangled up. They'll reach the light on their own."
Clemont: "I can show you the circuit after I get the lights back on. Okay, after they've been on for a while."
Valerie: "I save the cloth our partners have worn through. New cloth never hangs quite like it."
Olympia: "Your turn on the road will come whether I tell you or not. Enjoy not knowing for a little while."
Wulfric: "The Pokémon waiting outside followed me here when they were hungry. You can go out slow and let them look at you."
Milo: "When the Wooloo bunch up near the gate, I try standing still. Took me a while to learn I could."
Nessa: "When you're underwater all you can hear is your own breath. Funny how much you can remember when that's all there is."
Kabu: "I have tonight's loss to go over. That's a good thing to get at my age."
Bea: "Take some tape for your wrist if you need it. I always keep more than I think I'll use."
Allister: "They're loud through the wall. I like the ones who stay until my team's been checked."
Opal: "I liked you best on the turn you thought I'd stopped watching."
Gordie: "I polish the front. Mum always tells me to check what the pin's doing on the back."
Melony: "I still keep hot water in the passage. Nobody looks dignified when they need it, so I leave them alone."
Piers: "Best sound I heard all night was my partner settling down after the match."
Raihan: "I don't mind the clips when I win. I could stand to watch a few more where I don't."
Katy: "I made one more than we needed this morning. Would you like to take that, too?"
Brassius: "Some of my work looks different when I lose. I've kept a couple of pieces for days like this."
Iono: "There's a delay before the picture hits the stream. I like those seconds. Sometimes I can use my own voice."
Kofu: "Go round the market's back if the front's busy. A stall there will do you a bowl on my word."
Larry: "Take your time if you're eating before the next town. People get strange about lunch for something everybody needs."
Ryme: "Give me half a beat before you speak. The room's still carrying the end of it."
Tulip: "Fill in that first line for me before you leave. The people here ought to see what doing it well looked like."
Grusha: "I used to think you could decide, standing at the top, how a fall was going to end."
